issue.message: This domain already meets the BIMI bar, DMARC is at enforcement, so it qualifies to show a brand logo next to its mail. Publish a BIMI record pointing at an SVG Tiny PS logo to claim it.

inputs.label: Logo URL (SVG Tiny PS)
inputs.help: An HTTPS URL serving your logo as an SVG Tiny Portable/Secure file. It is validated before anything is published.

inputs.label: Mark Certificate URL
inputs.help: The PEM chain of your Verified or Common Mark Certificate. Gmail and Apple Mail only display logos backed by one.
